scope: NekoClaw plugin runs whose run_id is known but terminal status cannot be read after repeated polling transport/protocol failures.

native_gap.poller: nekoclaw/host/plugin_runs.py returns status=failed with lost=true after MAX_CONSECUTIVE_POLL_ERRORS, even though RunOutcome explicitly documents unknown as a valid last status.
native_gap.cancellation: the runner asks the server to cancel the lost run, but a cancel can race after a real external effect; cancellation acceptance is not proof that the effect never happened.
native_gap.server_evidence: POST /runs/{run_id}/cancel returns the current RunRecord. If the run was already terminal, manager.cancel_run returns that terminal record unchanged.
native_gap.direct_route: plugin_terminal_status currently maps every success=false to failed, and TaskBrain maps failed to a terminal commission that native ledger rules explicitly allow to be taken up again.
native_gap.gateway: CapabilityGateway turns failed plugin outcomes into MCP tool errors, which invites task-agent retry even though the effect may already exist.

reuse_order.candidate: N.E.K.O current pin RunOutcome unknown status + commission blocked status + existing plugin run cancellation
reuse_order.reason: RunOutcome already reserves unknown, and blocked is already the native commission state for work that must not continue automatically.
No newer upstream unknown-effect reconciliation semantics exist at review time.

reuse_order.candidate: N.E.K.O Plugin Run API / NekoClaw gateway / native ledger
reuse_order.reason: Existing run_id, RunRecord, cancel path, call audit, blocked commission semantics and gateway result channel are sufficient; no new store or protocol is required.
The ambiguity occurs inside N.E.K.O's host-to-plugin run protocol before any surface-specific component.
Temporal/Restate-style replacement would duplicate the frozen NekoClaw execution and ledger authority for a gap already representable with native states.
Classify lost polling as existing unknown, map direct work to existing blocked semantics, and return a non-error no-repeat safety result to task agents.
Would create a second execution-state authority.

candidate_contract.unknown_source: Only a run whose run_id was created and whose terminal state became unreadable after repeated polling failures is effect-unknown.
candidate_contract.runner: Return RunOutcome.status=unknown and reason=effect_uncertain; keep best-effort native cancel behavior but never interpret cancel acceptance as proof of failure.
candidate_contract.direct_plugin: Map status=unknown to the existing blocked commission state, not failed, so native scheduling does not automatically continue it.
candidate_contract.gateway: Return an explicit non-error tool result stating that the effect is uncertain and the same action must not be repeated automatically. This prevents the runtime's ordinary tool-error retry path while allowing the task agent to report uncertainty.
candidate_contract.audit: Record the call as blocked/uncertain via existing call audit fields; no new audit table.
candidate_contract.reconciliation: A later positive native terminal result may be handled by future reconciliation work; absence of evidence never changes unknown into failed.
forbidden: automatic fresh execution after an unknown outcome

machine_acceptance: Repeated unreadable/transport status polls produce status=unknown rather than failed.
The existing lost-run cancel path still runs and remains tracked until cancel acceptance.
A direct plugin commission with unknown effect becomes blocked, not failed.
A gateway plugin call with unknown effect returns a non-error no-repeat safety result and records plugin_run_ended status unknown.
Existing plugin runner, task brain, gateway and run-manager regressions stay green.
retirement_condition: Delete this candidate when upstream N.E.K.O natively distinguishes unknown plugin effect from confirmed failure across PluginRunner, direct commissions and task-agent gateway calls, with equivalent no-blind-retry and reconciliation coverage.
conclusion: THIN_NATIVE_SEMANTICS_CANDIDATE. Reuse RunOutcome unknown and native blocked/tool-result semantics; do not create another effect-state authority.
